title: No Leaderboard
description: Serverside mod that disables the tab leaderboard/playerlist when in multiplayer.
body:
Disables the multiplayer playerlist/leaderboard by spoofing the packet to return no players. Players can still use the tab key to show the leaderboard, but it will show no players at all.

Does not require clients to have it installed when on the server.
